title: Environment inventory
rows: C++ compiler and core build tools (gcc, g++, make). Any GCC >= 9 suffices for the intel-llvm -fsycl host pass. (nothing to install on windows)
GoogleTest (unit / integration test framework). Shared: every module tests with it. (gtest)
OpenCL ICD loader + dev headers (exposes CPU as a SYCL device) (opencl)
pkg-config implementation (CMake uses it to locate hwloc and other libs) (pkgconf)
NVIDIA — installs CUDA toolkit (NVIDIA installer, one UAC prompt)
NVIDIA CUDA toolkit (nvcc) -> C:\Program Files\NVIDIA GPU Computing Toolkit\CUDA\v12.6\bin\nvcc.EXE
Hardware locality library (topology / NUMA discovery). The runtime links it for the hardware topology layer. (hwloc)
Dear ImGui with the GLFW and OpenGL3 backends; the desktop application's UI. (imgui[glfw-binding,opengl3-binding])
GLFW window and input; the desktop application's window. (glfw3)
JSON for Modern C++; the desktop application's contract parser. (nlohmann-json)

SDL2 window/input/Vulkan-surface layer for the editor shell (se editor). The [vulkan] feature enables SDL's Vulkan surface path, which the editor's Vulkan backend requires. Editor is OFF by default, so this is optional for a plain library build. (sdl2[vulkan])
Vulkan API headers for the renderer (se build --render). Renderer is OFF by default, so this is optional for a plain library build. (vulkan-headers)
Vulkan loader (vulkan-1 import library + ICD loader) the renderer links against. Paired with vulkan-headers. (vulkan-loader)
AMD Vulkan Memory Allocator (VMA) — the renderer's GPU allocator. (vulkan-memory-allocator)
vk-bootstrap — Vulkan instance/device/swapchain selection boilerplate for the renderer. (vk-bootstrap)
glslang (GLSL -> SPIR-V). Used by a build-time host tool that compiles the renderer's shaders to embedded SPIR-V headers; not a runtime dependency. (glslang)

Khronos Vulkan validation layers. Not linked and not shipped: the loader picks the layer up at runtime when a build asks for it, which is how a synchronization or usage error in a new pass is caught as a message instead of as a device loss. Development only. (vulkan-validationlayers)

stb_image / stb_image_write — header-only image decode for the renderer's texture library (albedo, normal, MR/ORM, height, emissive maps). Renderer is OFF by default, so this is optional for a plain library build. (stb)

cgltf — header-only glTF 2.0 parser backing the renderer's mesh and material import (incl. KHR_materials_* extensions). Renderer is OFF by default, so this is optional for a plain library build. (cgltf)

libopus + libopusfile (+libogg) — compressed audio codec for the audio subsystem's bank/streaming (music & dialogue). Decoded behind the IAudioCodec seam. Audio is OFF by default, so this is optional for a plain library build. (opusfile)

minimp3 — header-only MP3 decode for the sound library, the same shape as stb above: public domain, no link dependency, so a shipped game inherits no codec licence. Chosen over mpg123, which is LGPL and would have to be linked. Audio is OFF by default, so this is optional for a plain library build. (minimp3)

libvorbis (+libogg) — the Ogg Vorbis decoder behind the IAudioCodec seam. Audio::VorbisCodec has been in the tree since the audio subsystem was written but only samples/audio linked it; declaring it here is what lets a .ogg reach the sound library. Audio is OFF by default, so this is optional for a plain library build. (libvorbis)

HDF5 — the container format SOFA HRIR files use, for measured-HRTF binaural spatialization. Built without the szip feature (its libaec source mirror rate-limits and SOFA needs no szip). Audio is OFF by default and HDF5 is only needed for measured HRTF, so this is optional. (hdf5[core,zlib])

meshoptimizer — the import-time geometry cooker's optimization kernels: vertex remap, LOD simplification with attribute weights, vertex-cache and overdraw ordering, vertex fetch, the shadow index buffer, and the quantization helpers. Host-only, used by engine/asset/cooking; no device and no renderer needed to build it. (meshoptimizer)

message: Vendored dependencies go in one folder: D:\Projects\sushistack\dependencies
Remove the whole install by deleting that folder (`hub remove --all` does it for you).
System prerequisites kept outside that folder: the C++ host compiler (Visual Studio Build Tools + Windows SDK), git, and the toolkit for the detected GPU.
